claim: Qwen WAV admission rejects RIFF chunks whose four-byte identifier contains non-printable binary or control bytes.
implementation: src/wav.js validates every chunk identifier as printable ASCII before interpreting or skipping the chunk.
test/qwen-tts.test.js injects a structurally bounded unknown chunk containing a NUL identifier byte and requires QWEN_TTS_RESULT_INVALID.
limitations: This is synthetic local qualification and does not prove the real Qwen service encoding or media quality.
Real synthesis and retained-media graphical-browser E2E remain separately human-gated.
